title: Isolation of Matrix Metalloproteinases (MMP)-expressing cells from Stromal Vascular Fraction
author: Aoi Satoh
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p59dq96
materials: Weight Collagenase D (f.c. 1.5 U/ml) and Dispase II (f.c. 2.4 U/ml) in 50 ml tube. Collagenase D 7.5 U/tissue Dispase II 12 U/tissue Collagenase D Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #11088866001 Dispase II (neutral protease, grade II) Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #4942078001
Mince with scissors until approximately 1 mm pieace

Stop digestion by adding 5 ml of 0.5 % BSA in PBS + EDTA (autoMACS Rinsing Solution). Bovine Serum Albumin solution Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #A1595-50ML autoMACS Rinsing Solution Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-091-222
Proceed to sort by BD FACSAria II.

steps.title: Prepare digestion buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve digestion buffer to a final volume of 10 ml per tissue (2–5 mice) using the appropriate amount of PBS; sacrifice mice before dissolving.

steps.title: Activate buffer with CaCl2
steps.instruction: Add CaCl₂ solution (Merck MilliporeSigma, Cat #21115‑100ML) to the digestion buffer to a final concentration of 10 mM, then shake in a 37 °C water bath for less than 10 min.

steps.title: Harvest adipose tissue
steps.instruction: Sacrifice mice, excise adipose tissue, and place it on a sterile 10 cm dish containing PBS at room temperature (RT).

steps.title: Digest tissue
steps.instruction: Pat residual PBS from the tissue with a Kimwipe, add 2 ml of the activated digestion buffer to the tissue in the dish, transfer the mixture to a 50 ml tube, and incubate in a 37 °C water bath for 1 hour, gently shaking by hand every 10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Spin at 300 g for 5 min at RT, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 1 ml of 0.5 % BSA in PBS + EDTA (autoMACS Rinsing Solution).

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 100 µm cell strainer (Corning, Cat #431752) into a new 50 ml tube, then repeat the filtration using a 40 µm strainer (Corning, Cat #431750).

steps.title: Second centrifugation and cold resuspension
steps.instruction: Spin at 300 g for 5 min at RT, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 80 µl cold (4 °C) 0.5 % BSA in PBS + EDTA.

steps.title: Add depletion cocktail and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl Non‑Adipocyte Progenitor Depletion Cocktail (mouse, Miltenyi Biotec, Cat #130‑106‑639), mix gently, and incubate 15 min at 4 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Centrifuge Lin‑ cells
steps.instruction: Spin the collected Lin‑ cells at 300 g for 5 min at RT, discard the supernatant, and resuspend in 100 µl of 1 % BSA in PBS + EDTA.

steps.title: Fc block
steps.instruction: Add 2 µl TruStain fcX™ (anti‑mouse CD16/32) antibody (0.5 mg/ml, BioLegend, Cat #101319), mix, and incubate 10 min on ice protected from light.

steps.title: Wash after Fc block
steps.instruction: Add 900 µl of 1 % BSA in PBS + EDTA, mix, then spin at 300 g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Fix cells
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl of Click‑iT fixative (4 % paraformaldehyde in PBS), mix, and incubate 15 min at RT protected from light.

steps.title: Wash after fixation
steps.instruction: Add 900 µl of 1 % BSA in PBS + EDTA, mix, spin at 300 g for 5 min at RT, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare permeabilization buffer
steps.instruction: Make permeabilization buffer containing 0.3 % Triton X‑100 in 1 % BSA in PBS + EDTA; keep at RT (≈25 °C).

steps.title: Permeabilize cells (first)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl permeabilization buffer, mix, and incubate 15 min at RT protected from light.

steps.title: Stain MMP‑3
steps.instruction: Add labeled MMP‑3 antibody (1:200 dilution, Invitrogen, Cat #MA5‑17123), mix, and incubate 10 min on ice protected from light.

steps.title: Wash after staining
steps.instruction: Add 900 µl permeabilization buffer, mix, spin at 300 g for 5 min at 4 °C, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Final resuspension and loading
steps.instruction: Suspend cells in 500 µl permeabilization buffer and transfer to a 5 ml polystyrene round‑bottom tube with cell‑strainer cap (Falcon, Cat #352235).
